proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5071 *chōṭṭa gives regional choṭā/choṭo small. The selected aspirated choṭa adjective specifies the younger sibling. The second component is sister (CDIAL 9349 bhaginī, regional bahin/bahan/bon/bhaüṇī). Two ordered etymological component links preserve the complete response; they do not assert one inherited Sanskrit compound or resolve internal Indo-Aryan transmission. Exact response: choṭibahan.
